```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# This chunk loads the data but won't show up in your final report
# Ensure your CSV is in the same folder as this RMD file
data <- read.csv(file.choose("Alzheimers Mice Data.csv"))

# Crucial step: Convert to factors so R treats them as groups, not numbers
data$AD_Status <- as.factor(data$AD_Status)
data$Treatment <- as.factor(data$Treatment)
```

## Training Day Analysis
We examine if drug treatment or Alzheimer's status affected initial learning.

```{r training-anova}
train_model <- aov(Training ~ AD_Status * Treatment, data = data)
summary(train_model)
```

## Memory Day Analysis
We examine the effects on memory retention (the main goal of the study).

```{r memory-anova}
memory_model <- aov(Memory ~ AD_Status * Treatment, data = data)
summary(memory_model)
```

## Visualizing Interactions
If the interaction term (AD_Status:Treatment) is significant, this plot helps show which drug helped which group.

```{r interaction-plot}
interaction.plot(x.factor = data$Treatment, 
                 trace.factor = data$AD_Status, 
                 response = data$Memory,
                 type = "b", # 'b' for both lines and points
                 pch = 19, 
                 col = c("red", "blue"),
                 xlab = "Drug Treatment",
                 ylab = "Mean Memory Errors",
                 trace.label = "AD Status")
```
